title: Reworld (Fabric)
description: Corrupt your world, with a single command.
body:
# Reworld (Experimental)

Reworld is an experimental world generation tool that allows you to merge different seeds within the same world using a single command.

# How to use: 

Use the command /corrupt-world [Seed, Optional] (original command) or /reworld (old command) to trigger the seed merging process.

# ⚠️ IMPORTANT: BACKUP REQUIRED

Since this mod performs deep modifications to chunk generation data to achieve the "merging" effect, it is highly recommended to create a backup of your world before running the command. Use it at your own risk in experimental environments.

# Technical Notes:

Environment: This is a Server-side mod. It is optional on the client but required on the server to function correctly.

Language: Please note that in-game messages and the interface are currently available in Spanish only.

Development: This project was developed with AI assistance for experimental purposes, focusing on unique and chaotic world generation patterns.

World Generation: This mod only affects newly generated chunks. It does not modify or damage chunks that have already been explored or built upon.
